entities.text: Nem Con Prime International Private Limited
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: Vs. Deepak Saraf Mr. Arindam Sen, Mr. Sourav Basu, Ms. Payal Maji

...for the petitioners IA No:
CRAN 1 of 2024 Petitioners undertake to file affidavit of service in the course of the day.
In spite of service opposite party is not represented.
Learned Counsel for the petitioners prays for stay of further proceeding of complaint case no.CN/3130/2023.

It is submitted on behalf of the petitioners that the averment in the complaint clearly discloses that there is no entrustment and the dispute between the parties only in connection with non-payment of commission out of the sale proceed.
There is no allegation that the petitioners have made any false representation which is a sine qua-non to attract Section 420 of the IPC.

No overt act has also been alleged against the petitioner no.1 being the company and the petitioner nos.2 and 3 who being the Directors of the company have been made liable vicariously which has no sanction under the offence of IPC.
Therefore, continuance of further proceeding before the Court below will be a mere abuse of the process of the Court.

Having heard learned Counsel for the petitioners and that the petitioners have made out an arguable case, let all further proceeding of the complaint case being no.CN/3130/2023 pending before learned Judicial Magistrate, 19th Court, Calcutta is stayed for a period of 12 weeks or until further order, whichever is earlier.
CRAN 1 of 2025 stands disposed of accordingly.
CRR 2523 of 2024 Let the matter be listed in the Monthly List of February, 2026.
Parties to act on a server copy of this order duly collected from the official website of the Hon'ble High Court, Calcutta.

( Dr. Ajoy Kumar Mukherjee, J. )
